The issue is "fix for padding width".
If `self.expand` is `True`, `width` is set to `options.max_width`.
Then `render_options` is created with `width - self.left - self.right`.
If `self.expand` is `True`, `width` is `options.max_width`, so `render_options` width is `options.max_width - self.left - self.right`.
This seems correct for `expand=True`.

If `self.expand` is `False`, `width` is `min(Measurement.get(...).maximum + self.left + self.right, options.max_width)`.
Then `render_options` width is `width - self.left - self.right`.
If `Measurement.get(...).maximum + self.left + self.right` is less than `options.max_width`, then `width` is `Measurement.get(...).maximum + self.left + self.right`.
Then `render_options` width is `Measurement.get(...).maximum`.
This also seems correct.
